answer: Each participant bonds 25 POA for twelve epochs and must complete five separate jobs reviewed by three randomly drawn peers with no shared backer. Two independent approvals are required; confirmed recycling of evidence burns 15% of the bond. Signed summaries and transfer logs stay public, so a juniper-like cluster of shared funding exposes linked puppets, a sonnet of identical phrasing reveals copy-paste answers, and velvet access to premium tasks appears only after real tenure. Multiplying identities multiplies bonds, jobs, and review checks, making fraud unprofitable.
